name: Bloom probabilistic membership filter
definition: B[h_j(x)]←1 for every hash j on insertion; query(x)=AND_j B[h_j(x)]
variables: B bit array; h_j hash maps; x key
assumptions: Insertion only and stable hashes; false-positive analysis assumptions pending review
limitations: False positives possible; standard filter does not support arbitrary deletion; full review pending
failure_conditions: Invalid bit array or inconsistent hash mapping
computation: Initialize bits to zero, set addressed bits for each insertion and test all addressed bits on query; verify probability model and edge cases before admission.
